buyer_added_terms.text: 1. Generic OPTION CLAUSE: The Purchaser reserves the right to increase or decrease the quantity to be ordered up to 25 percent of bid quantity at the time of placement of contract. The purchaser also reserves the right to increase the ordered quantity up to 25% of the contracted quantity during the currency of the contract at the contracted rates. The delivery period of quantity shall commence from the last date of original delivery order and in cases where option clause is exercised during the extended delivery period the additional time shall commence from the last date of extended delivery period. The additional delivery time shall be (Increased quantity ÷ Original quantity) × Original delivery period (in days), subject to minimum of 30 days. If the original delivery period is less than 30 days, the additional time equals the original delivery period. The Purchaser may extend this calculated delivery duration up to the original delivery period while exercising the option clause. Bidders must comply with these terms. 2. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses Delivery Period:-The contractual period for the supply of the Hydrogen gas is Two years fro m the date of receipt of GeM PO. The Gases will be supplied in lots as per the instruction given by the site-i n-charge on the behalf of PPCL. as under:- "Within 10 working days from the date of receipt of telephonicall y message, intimation or e-mail. Qty of the lot shall be 6-8 banks of H2 Cylinders (Each bank carrying 16 C ylinders) on the basis of the empty cylinders available on the PPS-III's site. Requirement of cylinders will be communicated by PPS-III and vendor shall supply the material within 10 days of such intimation which invo lves the lifting of empty cylinders/ Cylinders bank from PPS-III, Bawana site & to return the same after refilli ng at PPS-III, Bawana site".But in case of any emergent requirement in the plant the vendor should deliver the filled cylinder within three days from the date of intimation given by EIC. Qualifying Requirements:- A) Turnover The minimum average annual financial turnover of the bidder during the previous three years, ending on 3 1st March 2026, should be at least Rs. 19.6 Lakhs (30% of the estimated value). Documentary evidence in dicating the turnover details for the relevant period shall be in the form of certified audited Balance Sheets of relevant periods or certificates from the Chartered Accountant / Cost Accountant along with UDIN, to be uploaded with the bid. In case the date of constitution / incorporation of the bidder are less than 3 year old, the average turnover in respect of the completed financial years after the date of constitution shall be take n into account for these criteria. B) Past Project Performance I. Bidder or its OEM (themselves or through re-sellers) must have supplied at least 73584 M3 Hydrogen (H2 ) Gas with purity >= 99.9% (i.e. 80% of total indented qty of 91980 M3 ) per annum on an average during the last three years, before the bid opening date, to any Central/ State Govt. Organization/ PSU/ Public list ed Company.

For fulfilling the experience criteria any one of the following documents may be considered as valid proof f or meeting the experience criteria: 1. Purchase Order copy along with Invoice(s) with self certification by the bidder that supplies against the invoices have been executed. 2. Execution certificate by client with order value. 3. Any other document in support of order execution like third party inspection release note, etc. II. Bidder should furnish latest acknowledgement of Income Tax Return and GST Registration certificate. Note:- The turnover mentioned is tab of GeM bid is 20 lacs, however it may be considered a s 19.6 lacs as mentioned above since in tab. provided for turnover, only whole no is allowe d. Special T&C for participating vendors 1. Hydrogen Gas suitable for use in cooling of Turbo Generator ; purity greater & equal to 99.9%, Cylinder Gas volume is equal to 7 cubic meter(M3) at 150 bar. 2. Normally the cylinders used will be of M/s PPCL ownership however if supplier supplied in his own cylind er the same shall be rent free & should be hydraulically tested along with test certificate (comply with IS-7 285 ) & latest amendment & explosive act. 3 Cylinder loading/Unloading at PPCL store/site will be on PPCL account. 4. If the cylinder of PPCL is lost then the supplier will have to provide new hydraulically tested cylinder alon g with test certificate (comply with IS-7285 & latest amendment & explosive act.) as a replacement. 5. In case of any minor defect in the valve, the same to be attended by vendor free of cost. 6. Transportation of empty cylinder/bank from site (PPS-III, Bawana) and to return the same after refilling a t PPS-III, Bawana shall be in the scope of vendor. 7. Compressed Hydrogen gas should be as per IS 1090, Grade-1. Special Note:- 1. Guarantee warranty, PBG, Interchangeability are not applicable. However security deposit in the form of E-PBG @5% of GeM PO value is applicable which shall be released after successful completion of PO. 2. Test certificate is applicable and should be submitted along with the supply of each lot.

3. QVC is applicable as per PPCL NIT as per which PPCL can change the quantity to the extent of +/-20% of ordered quantity. 4. Quantity Tolerance clause is applicable which is +/- 0.5% of ordered quantity to account for any weighm ent variation 5.The contractual period for the supply of the hydrogen gases is two ye ars from the date of Order, but can be extended on the basis of past p erformance of the party during contractual period for next three month s with same Rate & Terms & Condition of existing PO, if required. 6. LD Clause is applicable as per GeM GTC. 7. Sellers/Bidders are advised not to participate in the bid from the same IP addresse s. The bid/offer of those firms will liable to be rejected, if it is observed/noticed that b idders have participated from the same IP address of two or more firms. . 3.
